title: Popeye session credential issuance request
description: Structural schema for the request in fiskroad/contracts/NONO_POPEYE_SESSION_CREDENTIAL_CONTRACT_v0.1.md section 2.1. It is a pre-review validation artifact, not an issuance implementation.

on_behalf_of.$comment: Whether this identifier resolves to an agent is an issuer-side identity lookup, not a request-shape assertion.

requested_ttl_seconds.$comment: The issuer clamps an integer to its configured maximum. A maximum is intentionally not encoded here.

device_ref.$comment: Opaque request field; its identity semantics remain subject to D-1.

$comment: Caller authorization is outside this body and remains subject to D-1.
